sources.name: AP 2026 midterm results hub (apnews.com)
sources.terms_note: Calls enter the calls layer by MANUAL ENTRY only: one append-only row per outlet call (outlet, basis, called_for, called_at_et as displayed, url, entered_by, entered_at; retractions are new rows). AP's raw election data API is licensed and is NOT scraped. robots.txt (fetched 2026-10-29) disallows /api/v2/feed/, /apdata/, widgets, *.rss and AI crawlers (ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, Claude-User, GPTBot, ...): do not automate fetches of apnews.com; read by eye.
